definitions.full: H2553. chamman [ חַמָּן ] noun masculine sun-pillar , used in idolatrous worship (see Thes 489ff. RS Semitic i, 469 , Lag M i, 228 Now Archaeology ii, 302 ; = Palmyrene חמנא Vog No. 123 a ; **+? N. Semitic Inscr., No. 136 ; Lzb Ephem. ii {1906}, 280 ; Phoenician חמן לבעל often as epithet of solar Baal); — only plural absolute חַמָּנִים Isa 27:9 4 t.; suffix חַמָּנֵיכֶם Lev 26:30 2 t.; || בָּמוֺת 26:30 (H), 2Chr 14:4 , compare Ezek 6:4 , 6 ; || הבעלים מזבחות 2Chr 34:4 ; || אשׁרים Isa 17:8 ; 27:9 ; || אשׁרים and מְּסִלִים 2Chr 34:7 .
